integrity: The self-contained reproducer uses only the standard Python library; it rebuilds all graph data and all signed Morse coefficients from the explicit graph definition, and completed with VERIFY_OK.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy classification is finite and exact for the single graph GP(8,3); no uniform family result. The complete signed Morse certificate is needed beyond mod-two homology. Unindexed equivalent earlier work remains a possible originality risk.
title: The Möbius–Kantor perfect-matching complex is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
